raceBoard.snapshot: Rust engine 1c93d34 (matches a667dce), 31 Oct, after the 30 Oct hotfix and the 26 Oct racial update

raidRotation: Keep Shadow Word: Pain on the boss. Improved Shadow Word: Pain lengthens it.
Devouring Plague on cooldown (now every 24 sec). Its damage heals you.
Mind Blast on cooldown.
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown when you can afford the backlash (30% of max health if it doesn't kill, up from 10% in the 30 Oct hotfix). Under 20% boss health, Early Demise adds crit.
Mind Flay as filler. Let channels finish: later ticks hit harder and a full channel triggers Dark Inspiration.
Vampiric Embrace every 30 sec for party healing.
stats: Spell power (Shadow damage) first.
Crit is stronger than in Classic. DoTs can crit and Shadowform doubles the crit damage bonus.
Spell hit matters for a raid boss three levels higher. Shadow Focus gives some.
Intellect for Mana, Stamina to survive Shadow Word: Death backlash.
'of Shadow Wrath' greens dominate early Shadow gear lists. Grab them from the Auction House while levelling.
Healing gear gives one-third of its healing as spell damage. Keep a separate healing set only if you off-heal a lot.
shadow-priest.summary: Priest's only DPS spec: damage over time, Mind Blast and Mind Flay. Shadowform halves the Mana cost of Shadow spells and doubles their crit bonus, but you must leave it to heal.
talentNotes: Shadowform needs 31 Shadow points plus Vampiric Embrace. That leaves 20 points for Discipline mana talents.
New: Improved Mind Flay, Dark Inspiration, Devouring Contagion, Early Demise.
Removed: Shadow Affinity, Improved Fade, Improved Vampiric Embrace.
Shadow Weaving is now a personal buff (up to 10% Shadow damage). It no longer boosts Warlocks.
Devouring Plague and Fear Ward are baseline for every Priest at 20, Divine Spirit at 30 and Shadow Word: Death at 32.
threatMana: Shadow Affinity is gone, so you have no talent threat reduction. Let the tank build threat before you open up.
Ask a Paladin for Salvation. Blizzard says it will stop being a blessing in a future beta build, so you can then have Salvation and a damage blessing together.
Shadowform halves the Mana cost of Shadow spells.
Vampiric Embrace can proc Spirit Tap for extra Mana regeneration.
